# Why Hiiaka is spelled that way — and what it costs to get it right

There is a version of this name the early internet had to settle for: *hiiaka*. This is the file on how **Hiiaka** replaced it.

The stories of Hiiaka place hula, magic, healing at the center of a living mythological world.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Hiiaka
- **ASCII form:** hiiaka
- **Meaning:** "patron goddess of Hawaiʻi"
- **Domain of influence:** Hula, Magic, Healing
- **Pantheon:** Polynesian
- **Classification:** Tier 2
- **Original script:** —
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 211 of 546

## The Name Before the Marks


Spoken, the name runs `/hiiaka/` — say "hiiaka" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Hiiaka".

## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Hiiaka** lives at [/hiiaka/](/hiiaka/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/hiiaka/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/hiiaka/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/hiiaka/patterns/).

The restoration keeps one feature the ASCII form drops. One is enough to matter, and the label says so plainly: Tier-2.

## The Archetype at Work

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) seats this temple in **4 industries**, each match argued and weighted: **Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine** (primary seat: Hiiaka embodies hula, magic, healing — the core of healthcare pharma.); **Biotech, Longevity & Life Sciences** (resonant seat: Hiiaka shares symbolic territory with biotech longevity.); **Mental Health & Emotional Wellness** (resonant seat: Hiiaka shares symbolic territory with mental health.). The [Resonance File](/hiiaka/blog/resonance/) reads those seats through the myths themselves.

The Polynesian tradition is not a vibe; it is a library. The [Sacred Texts collection](/texts/) holds [Kumulipo](/texts/kumulipo/) and [Polynesian Mythology](/texts/polynesian-mythology/) — the primary sources the temple's scholarship is built on. The temple is the argument; the texts are the evidence.

## The Emblems

The name does not travel alone. **Name** — The restored form Hiiaka, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.; **Domain** — Hula, Magic, Healing. Each emblem is filed in the temple's record with its own provenance, the same discipline the spelling gets.

## For the Voice

Say "hiiaka" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Hiiaka". The reconstructed line runs `/hiiaka/` — the temple's pronunciation atlas carries the phonemes one by one.

## The Discipline It Answers To

This restoration belongs to Polynesian, a tradition that navigated by names the way it navigated by stars. The rules that govern it are not house style; they are the tradition's own scholarship, applied with the same care here as in any edition — and published, with the sources, so the file can be checked the way an edition can be checked. The restoration keeps one feature the ASCII form drops. One is enough to matter, and the label says so plainly: Tier-2.
